verdict.rationale: Meltano documents scheduled pipeline orchestration via Apache Airflow and CLI-driven runs (meltano run), enabling recurring job execution, but this relies on an external orchestrator rather than a native built-in scheduler, and there's no first-party evidence of AI-native job scheduling specifics. Missing for 10: native built-in scheduler details, independent hands-on confirmation of scheduling reliability, AI-agent-specific workflow triggering.
